## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] New or changed tunable values are in `configs/` and `docs/PARAMETERS.md` with their origin
- [ ] `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/OPERATIONS.md` and the README match the change
- [ ] Results say "not known" when the evidence is missing
- [ ] Screens checked in light and dark mode and at phone width, with no blue
- [ ] `?v=` asset version raised if a script or stylesheet changed
- [ ] No credentials, real case data, datasets or model weights added
- [ ] New data has its source and licence in `SOURCES.md` and `NOTICE.md`
